description: Source code for a JavaScript/TypeScript class that generates Playwright test scripts in JavaScript, including methods for action generation, header/footer templates, and code formatting.

classes.name: JavaScriptLanguageGenerator
classes.description: A class that generates JavaScript code for Playwright tests, supporting both test and standalone modes.

classes.name: JavaScriptFormatter
classes.description: A helper class for formatting generated code with proper indentation and line management.

methods.name: generateAction
methods.description: Generates JavaScript code for a specific user action within a test context.

methods.name: _generateActionCall
methods.description: Creates code snippets for individual actions based on their type.

methods.name: generateHeader
methods.description: Produces the header part of the test script depending on mode.

methods.name: generateFooter
methods.description: Produces the footer part of the test script depending on mode.

methods.name: generateTestHeader
methods.description: Generates the header for a Playwright test using '@playwright/test'.

methods.name: generateTestFooter
methods.description: Generates the footer for a Playwright test.

methods.name: generateStandaloneHeader
methods.description: Generates the header for a standalone Playwright script.

methods.name: generateStandaloneFooter
methods.description: Generates the footer for a standalone Playwright script.
